title: Benefits Admin Handoff
task_prompt:
## task_008: Downstream Candidate -- Benefits Admin Handoff

Write a professional yet conversational HR email to an employee regarding their HealthFirst open enrollment documentation for dependents. The message should:
- Inquire whether any dependent enrollment paperwork remains incomplete
- Request separate verification for each specific category: spouse coverage, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, and HSA records
- Explicitly clarify that these items should be reviewed individually rather than treated as a single consolidated packet
- Balance workplace professionalism with a warm, approachable tone suitable for the recipient
answer:
I've drafted a professional yet conversational HR email for the HealthFirst open enrollment dependent documentation check-in. Here is the final email:

---

**To:** [Employee Name]  
**From:** HR Benefits Administration  
**Subject:** HealthFirst Open Enrollment – Dependent Coverage Check-In

Hi [Employee Name],

I hope this message finds you well! As we're working through the HealthFirst open enrollment period, I wanted to reach out regarding your dependent coverage documentation.

Could you let me know if you have any outstanding paperwork still pending for your dependents' enrollment? To help ensure everything is processed smoothly and nothing falls through the cracks, I'd appreciate it if you could review and confirm the status of each item separately—rather than as a single consolidated packet. This helps us catch any individual gaps that might be easy to overlook when grouped together.

Specifically, could you verify your documentation for:

• **Spouse coverage** – enrollment forms and eligibility proof  
• **Medical insurance** – dependent enrollment and carrier forms  
• **Dental insurance** – separate election and coverage details  
• **Vision insurance** – enrollment confirmation for dependents  
• **HSA records** – beneficiary designations and contribution elections (if applicable)

If any of these categories are already complete, no problem—just let me know which ones have been submitted. If you have questions about a specific form or aren't sure what's still needed, I'm happy to walk through it together.

Feel free to reply here or give me a call, whichever is easier. I'm here to make sure your enrollment goes as smoothly as possible.

Thanks for your time, and I look forward to hearing from you!

Warm regards,

[Your Name]  
Benefits Administrator  
[Company Name]  
[Phone] | [Email]
